# A. Warm-Up {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #00C9A7)"}

Yesterday you built **P** (`error × KP`).
Today: add D braking, then build your own motion library. I is an optional demonstration. 📦

```{=html}
<script>
/* The one 5 ms tick of the turn-to-90 sim (kd = 0 -> pure P), shared by both
   PID sims on this deck. This is curriculum physics rather than shared chrome,
   so it lives here and not in sim-kit.js -- hung off SIM so the deck still
   introduces no global of its own. The car and the DOM/geometry helpers this
   deck used to define for itself now come from the kit. */
SIM.pidTick = function (s, kd) {
  var sd=0.005, err=90-s.h, change=err-s.lastErr; s.lastErr=err;
  var cmd=12*err + kd*(change/sd);
  if(cmd>450)cmd=450; if(cmd<-450)cmd=-450;
  s.v += (cmd-s.v)*Math.min(5*sd,1);
  s.h += s.v*0.5*sd; s.t+=sd;
};
</script>
```

# B. Finish the Word: D and I {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #FF7A5C)"}

- **P** knows how far is left
- **D** tracks how fast you close
- **I** fights friction and drag

## Break it: P in a hurry 🔥

```{=html}
<div class="sim">
  <div class="sim-controls">
    <button class="sim-btn coral" data-sim="phRun">▶ gyro_turn_p(90), KP cranked 🔥</button>
  </div>
  <div class="sim-stage">
    <svg width="200" height="200" viewBox="-105 -105 210 210" style="display:block;">
      <circle r="86" fill="#eef3f8" stroke="#1C355E" stroke-width="5"/>
      <g id="phTick"><line x1="0" y1="-86" x2="0" y2="-101" stroke="#00AE8D" stroke-width="6" transform="rotate(90)"/></g>
      <path id="phArc" d="" fill="none" stroke="#E96852" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0"/>
      <g id="phNeedle"><use href="#sim-bot" style="--bot:#FF7A5C"/></g>
    </svg>
    <div style="font-family:Consolas,monospace;font-size:20px;color:#1C355E;min-width:300px;">
      <div style="margin-bottom:6px;">heading = <span id="phHdg" style="font-weight:800;color:#FF7A5C;">0</span>° &nbsp;<span style="opacity:.6;font-size:15px;">target 90°</span></div>
      <div style="height:20px;background:#eef3f8;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:12px;position:relative;">
        <div style="position:absolute;left:calc(90/110*100%);top:0;width:2px;height:100%;background:#00AE8D;"></div>
        <div id="phHdgBar" style="height:100%;width:0%;background:#FF7A5C;opacity:.55;"></div>
      </div>
      <div id="phMsg" style="font-size:17px;color:#625D9C;font-weight:700;min-height:52px;">P sprints in… and slams the door. 🚪</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function(){
  var raf=null, last=null;
  function run(){
    var s={h:0,v:0,lastErr:90,t:0}, peak=0, done=false;
    SIM.el('phMsg').textContent='P sprints in… watch it ring. 🔔';
    SIM.el('phMsg').style.color='#625D9C';
    SIM.el('phArc').setAttribute('d',''); SIM.el('phArc').setAttribute('opacity','0');
    function frame(now){
      var dt=last?Math.min((now-last)/1000,0.05):0.016; last=now;
      var n=Math.max(1,Math.round(dt/0.005));
      for(var i=0;i<n && !done;i++){
        SIM.pidTick(s, 0);
        if(s.h>peak)peak=s.h;
        if(s.t>4){ done=true; }
      }
      SIM.el('phNeedle').setAttribute('transform','rotate('+s.h.toFixed(1)+')');
      SIM.el('phHdg').textContent=s.h.toFixed(0);
      SIM.el('phHdgBar').style.width=Math.max(0,Math.min(s.h/110*100,100))+'%';
      if(peak>90){ SIM.el('phArc').setAttribute('d',SIM.arcD(90,peak,94)); SIM.el('phArc').setAttribute('opacity','1'); }
      if(!done){ raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame); }
      else{
        raf=null;
        SIM.el('phMsg').innerHTML='shot to <b>'+peak.toFixed(0)+'°</b> (past the tick), swung back, and rang before settling. 😬';
        SIM.el('phMsg').style.color='#E96852';
      }
    }
    if(raf)cancelAnimationFrame(raf); last=null; raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  SIM.def('phRun', run);
})();
</script>
```

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
::: {.cardbox .coral}
<h3>Why P overshoots</h3>

- Checks **how far** is left, not **how fast** it is closing
- Full speed at arrival means momentum carries it past 90°
- Crank KP higher and it rings even harder
:::
:::

::: {.notes}
Run it before the fragment. The red arc past the tick is overshoot made visible. Ask students: "the number hit 90 — why didn't it stop?" Because the wheels were spinning at high speed. P cuts power at error 0, but momentum carries the robot past. Then P pulls back, creating oscillation. We need a way to detect that the error is dropping fast and ease off early.
:::

```{=html}
</div>
<script>
(function(){
  var SD=0.005, F=1.2, LAG=0.1, CAP=650;
  var kp=4, s=null, raf=null, coastT=null, playing=false, codeOn=true;
  var LINES={setup:[0,1], ask:[2], measure:[3], push:[4,5], blink:[6], exit:[7]};
  var CARDS={ask:0, measure:1, push:2, blink:3};
  function fresh(){ return {h:0,v:0,err:null,cmd:0,cmdc:0,pc:0,passes:0,peak:0,done:false}; }
  function beatOf(pc){ return pc===0?'setup':pc===1?'ask':pc===2?'measure':pc===3?'push':pc===4?'blink':'exit'; }
  function msg(t,c){ if(playing)return; SIM.el('brMsg').innerHTML=t; SIM.el('brMsg').style.color=c||'#625D9C'; }
  function row(id,txt,fl){ var e=SIM.el(id); e.textContent=txt; if(fl&&!playing){ e.style.background='#FFD50088'; setTimeout(function(){e.style.background='transparent';},300); } }
  function highlight(){
    var b=playing?null:beatOf(s.pc);
    for(var i=0;i<4;i++){ SIM.el('brB'+i).className='brBeat'+((b&&CARDS[b]===i)?' on':''); }
    for(var j=0;j<8;j++){ SIM.el('brC'+j).className='brln'+((b&&LINES[b].indexOf(j)>=0)?' on':''); }
  }
  function drawBot(){
    SIM.el('brCar').setAttribute('transform','rotate('+s.h.toFixed(1)+')');
    if(s.peak>90){ SIM.el('brArc').setAttribute('d',SIM.arcD(90,s.peak,94)); SIM.el('brArc').setAttribute('opacity','1'); }
  }
  function doBeat(){
    if(s.done) return;
    var pc=s.pc;
    if(pc===0){ s.h=0; drawBot(); msg('called <b>gyro_turn_p(90, '+kp+')</b> (target 90°)'); s.pc=1; }
    else if(pc===1){
      var gap=Math.abs(90-s.h);
      row('brRGap',gap.toFixed(1),1);
      if(gap>1){ s.passes++; SIM.el('brPassN').textContent=s.passes; msg('🚪 <b>ASK</b>: gap '+gap.toFixed(1)+'° &gt; 1? YES → run body'); s.pc=2; }
      else { msg('🚪 <b>ASK</b>: gap '+gap.toFixed(1)+'° &le; 1 → close door and stop motors','#00AE8D'); s.pc=5; }
    }
    else if(pc===2){ s.err=90-s.h; row('brRGap',s.err.toFixed(1),1); msg('📏 <b>MEASURE</b>: error = <b>'+s.err.toFixed(1)+'°</b> remaining'); s.pc=3; }
    else if(pc===3){
      s.cmd=kp*s.err; s.cmdc=Math.max(-CAP,Math.min(CAP,s.cmd));
      var over=Math.abs(s.cmd)>CAP;
      row('brRCmd',s.cmd.toFixed(0)+(over?' ⚠':''),1);
      msg('🦵 <b>PUSH</b>: push = '+kp+' × '+s.err.toFixed(1)+' = <b>'+s.cmd.toFixed(0)+'</b>');
      s.pc=4;
    }
    else if(pc===4){
      s.v+=(s.cmdc-s.v)*LAG; s.h+=s.v*F*SD; if(s.h>s.peak)s.peak=s.h;
      drawBot();
      msg('😴 <b>BLINK</b>: wait(5), turned to <b>'+s.h.toFixed(1)+'°</b>');
      s.pc=1;
    }
    else if(pc===5){ finish(); return; }
    highlight();
  }
  function finish(){
    s.done=true; playing=false; SIM.el('brPlayB').innerHTML='▶▶ play'; s.pc=5; highlight();
    var exitV=s.v;
    function coast(){
      var moved=false;
      for(var i=0;i<3;i++){ if(Math.abs(s.v)>=1){ s.v*=0.55; s.h+=s.v*F*SD; moved=true; } }
      if(s.h>s.peak)s.peak=s.h; drawBot();
      if(moved){ coastT=setTimeout(coast,30); }
      else{
        coastT=null;
        var hot = s.peak>91.5 || Math.abs(exitV)>30, lazy = !hot && s.passes>450, t, col;
        if(hot){
          t='🔔 Overshot to <b>'+s.peak.toFixed(1)+'°</b>. The door checks gap, not speed!'; col='#E96852';
        } else if(lazy){
          t='😴 Took <b>'+s.passes+'</b> passes. On a real robot, weak pushes stall short.'; col='#625D9C';
        } else {
          t='✅ Landed cleanly at <b>'+s.h.toFixed(1)+'°</b> in '+s.passes+' passes.'; col='#00AE8D';
        }
        SIM.el('brMsg').innerHTML=t; SIM.el('brMsg').style.color=col;
      }
    }
    coast();
  }
  function pass(){ if(s.pc===0) doBeat(); do{ doBeat(); }while(!s.done && s.pc!==1); }
  SIM.def('brStep', function(){ if(playing)SIM.run('brPlay'); doBeat(); });
  SIM.def('brPass', function(){ if(playing)SIM.run('brPlay'); pass(); });
  SIM.def('brPlay', function(){
    if(s.done)return;
    playing=!playing;
    SIM.el('brPlayB').innerHTML=playing?'⏸ pause':'▶▶ play';
    highlight();
    if(playing){
      SIM.el('brMsg').innerHTML='⏩ Fast-forward loop execution (~200× per second)'; SIM.el('brMsg').style.color='#625D9C';
      function frame(){ if(!playing||s.done)return; var n=s.passes>300?12:s.passes>120?6:1; for(var i=0;i<n&&!s.done;i++)pass(); if(playing&&!s.done)raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame); }
      raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }
  });
  SIM.def('brReset', function(){
    if(raf)cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf=null; if(coastT)clearTimeout(coastT); coastT=null; playing=false; s=fresh();
    SIM.el('brPlayB').innerHTML='▶▶ play'; SIM.el('brPassN').textContent='0';
    row('brRGap','–'); row('brRCmd','–');
    SIM.el('brCar').setAttribute('transform','rotate(0)'); SIM.el('brArc').setAttribute('opacity','0'); SIM.el('brArc').setAttribute('d','');
    SIM.el('brMsg').innerHTML='press <b>▶ next beat</b> to step through the turn 🧠'; SIM.el('brMsg').style.color='#625D9C';
    highlight();
  });
  SIM.def('brCode', function(){
    codeOn=!codeOn;
    SIM.el('brCodeCol').style.display=codeOn?'block':'none';
    SIM.el('brCodeB').textContent=codeOn?'{ } hide code':'{ } show code';
  });
  SIM.def('brSet', function(k){
    kp=k;
    var chips={4:['brChip4','#00AE8D'],1:['brChip1','#625D9C'],20:['brChip20','#E96852']};
    for(var key in chips){ var c=SIM.el(chips[key][0]), on=(+key===k); c.style.background=on?chips[key][1]:'#eef3f8'; c.style.color=on?'#fff':chips[key][1]; }
    SIM.run('brReset');
    if(k!==4) SIM.run('brPlay');
  });
  SIM.run('brReset');
})();
</script>
```

## Name it: D damps 🛑 {.code-shrink}

```{.python code-line-numbers="|1|3|4|5|6-7|8|10"}
def gyro_turn_pd(target, kp, kd):
    hub.imu.reset_heading(0)
    last_error = target
    while abs(target - hub.imu.heading()) > 1:
        error = target - hub.imu.heading()    # how FAR (P)
        change = (error - last_error) / 0.005 # how FAST (D, in °/s)
        last_error = error
        left.run(kp * error + kd * change)    # ease off early
        right.run(-(kp * error + kd * change))
        wait(5)
    left.stop(); right.stop()
```

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.cardbox .teal}
<h3>P (Proportional)</h3>

- Reads **where you are**
- Pushes hard when far
- Engine of the turn
:::
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.cardbox .coral}
<h3>D (Derivative)</h3>

- Reads **how fast gap closes**
- Taps the brake before arrival
- Stops ringing and overshoot 🛑
:::
:::
::::
:::

::: {.notes}
Call it with all three numbers, for example `gyro_turn_pd(90, 4, 0.5)`. Defaults arrive in the library section. Focus on the three new lines: remember last error, subtract to get rate of change, and combine into the motor command. When closing fast on the target, error shrinks each loop pass, making `change` negative. Multiplying by `kd` subtracts power, giving a smooth deceleration right into 90°.
:::

```{=html}
<div id="bdC6" class="brln">        last_error = error</div>
<div id="bdC7" class="brln">        left.run(kp * error + kd * change)</div>
<div id="bdC8" class="brln">        right.run(-(kp * error + kd * change))</div>
<div id="bdC9" class="brln">        wait(5)</div>
<div id="bdC10" class="brln">    left.stop(); right.stop()</div>
    </div>
    <div style="width:300px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;">
      <svg width="130" height="130" viewBox="-105 -105 210 210" style="display:block;flex:none;">
        <circle r="86" fill="#eef3f8" stroke="#1C355E" stroke-width="5"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="-86" x2="0" y2="-101" stroke="#00AE8D" stroke-width="6" transform="rotate(90)"/>
        <path id="bdArc" d="" fill="none" stroke="#E96852" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0"/>
        <g id="bdCar"><use href="#sim-bot" style="--bot:#625D9C"/></g>
      </svg>
      <div style="font-family:Consolas,monospace;font-size:13px;color:#1C355E;flex:1;">
        <div class="brrow"><span>gap (°)</span><b id="bdRGap">–</b></div>
        <div class="brrow"><span>change (°/s)</span><b id="bdRChg">–</b></div>
        <div class="brrow"><span>push (°/s)</span><b id="bdRCmd">–</b></div>
        <div style="padding:2px 8px;font-weight:800;">pass <span id="bdPassN" style="color:#625D9C;">0</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div id="bdMsg" style="text-align:center;font-size:14px;color:#625D9C;font-weight:700;min-height:34px;margin-top:5px;">watch 📉 SENSE feed the brake</div>
</div>
<script>
(function(){
  var SD=0.005, F=1.2, LAG=0.1, CAP=650;
  var PRESETS=[{kp:4,kd:0.5,id:'bdChip0',col:'#00AE8D'},{kp:20,kd:0,id:'bdChip1',col:'#E96852'},{kp:20,kd:0.5,id:'bdChip2',col:'#1C355E'},{kp:4,kd:1.6,id:'bdChip3',col:'#625D9C'}];
  var kp=4, kd=0.5, s=null, raf=null, coastT=null, playing=false;
  var LINES={setup:[0,1,2], ask:[3], measure:[4], sense:[5,6], push:[7,8], blink:[9], exit:[10]};
  var CARDS={ask:0, measure:1, sense:2, push:3, blink:4};
  function fresh(){ return {h:0,v:0,err:null,lastErr:90,change:0,cmd:0,cmdc:0,pc:0,passes:0,peak:0,done:false}; }
  function beatOf(pc){ return pc===0?'setup':pc===1?'ask':pc===2?'measure':pc===3?'sense':pc===4?'push':pc===5?'blink':'exit'; }
  function msg(t,c){ if(playing)return; SIM.el('bdMsg').innerHTML=t; SIM.el('bdMsg').style.color=c||'#625D9C'; }
  function row(id,txt,fl){ var e=SIM.el(id); e.textContent=txt; if(fl&&!playing){ e.style.background='#FFD50088'; setTimeout(function(){e.style.background='transparent';},300); } }
  function highlight(){
    var b=playing?null:beatOf(s.pc);
    for(var i=0;i<5;i++){ SIM.el('bdB'+i).className='brBeat'+((b&&CARDS[b]===i)?' on':''); }
    for(var j=0;j<11;j++){ SIM.el('bdC'+j).className='brln'+((b&&LINES[b].indexOf(j)>=0)?' on':''); }
  }
  function drawBot(){
    SIM.el('bdCar').setAttribute('transform','rotate('+s.h.toFixed(1)+')');
    if(s.peak>90){ SIM.el('bdArc').setAttribute('d',SIM.arcD(90,s.peak,94)); SIM.el('bdArc').setAttribute('opacity','1'); }
  }
  function doBeat(){
    if(s.done) return;
    var pc=s.pc;
    if(pc===0){ s.h=0; s.lastErr=90; drawBot(); msg('called <b>gyro_turn_pd(90, '+kp+', '+kd+')</b>'); s.pc=1; }
    else if(pc===1){
      var gap=Math.abs(90-s.h);
      row('bdRGap',gap.toFixed(1),1);
      if(gap>1){ s.passes++; SIM.el('bdPassN').textContent=s.passes; msg('🚪 <b>ASK</b>: gap '+gap.toFixed(1)+'° &gt; 1? YES'); s.pc=2; }
      else { msg('🚪 <b>ASK</b>: gap &le; 1° → motors stop','#00AE8D'); s.pc=6; }
    }
    else if(pc===2){ s.err=90-s.h; row('bdRGap',s.err.toFixed(1),1); msg('📏 <b>MEASURE</b>: error = <b>'+s.err.toFixed(1)+'°</b>'); s.pc=3; }
    else if(pc===3){
      var prev=s.lastErr;
      s.change=(s.err-prev)/SD; s.lastErr=s.err;
      row('bdRChg',s.change.toFixed(0),1);
      msg('📉 <b>SENSE</b>: closing speed = <b>'+s.change.toFixed(0)+' °/s</b>');
      s.pc=4;
    }
    else if(pc===4){
      var eng=kp*s.err, brk=kd*s.change;
      s.cmd=eng+brk; s.cmdc=Math.max(-CAP,Math.min(CAP,s.cmd));
      var over=Math.abs(s.cmd)>CAP;
      row('bdRCmd',s.cmd.toFixed(0)+(over?' ⚠':''),1);
      msg('🦵 <b>PUSH</b>: engine ('+eng.toFixed(0)+') + brake ('+brk.toFixed(0)+') = <b>'+s.cmd.toFixed(0)+'</b>');
      s.pc=5;
    }
    else if(pc===5){
      s.v+=(s.cmdc-s.v)*LAG; s.h+=s.v*F*SD; if(s.h>s.peak)s.peak=s.h;
      drawBot();
      msg('😴 <b>BLINK</b>: heading = <b>'+s.h.toFixed(1)+'°</b>');
      s.pc=1;
    }
    else if(pc===6){ finish(); return; }
    highlight();
  }
  function finish(){
    s.done=true; playing=false; SIM.el('bdPlayB').innerHTML='▶▶ play'; s.pc=6; highlight();
    var exitV=s.v;
    function coast(){
      var moved=false;
      for(var i=0;i<3;i++){ if(Math.abs(s.v)>=1){ s.v*=0.55; s.h+=s.v*F*SD; moved=true; } }
      if(s.h>s.peak)s.peak=s.h; drawBot();
      if(moved){ coastT=setTimeout(coast,30); }
      else{
        coastT=null;
        var ring=s.peak>91.5, crawl=!ring&&s.passes>450, t, col;
        if(ring){ t='🔔 kd = 0 (no brake) overshot to <b>'+s.peak.toFixed(1)+'°</b>.'; col='#E96852'; }
        else if(crawl){ t='🌊 High kd braked so early the robot crawled in late.'; col='#625D9C'; }
        else if(kp>=20){ t='🛑 Fast KP (20) + D brake: <b>no ring</b>, finished in '+s.passes+' passes.'; col='#1C355E'; }
        else { t='✅ Smooth glide: landed at <b>'+s.h.toFixed(1)+'°</b>.'; col='#00AE8D'; }
        SIM.el('bdMsg').innerHTML=t; SIM.el('bdMsg').style.color=col;
      }
    }
    coast();
  }
  function pass(){ if(s.pc===0) doBeat(); do{ doBeat(); }while(!s.done && s.pc!==1); }
  SIM.def('bdStep', function(){ if(playing)SIM.run('bdPlay'); doBeat(); });
  SIM.def('bdPass', function(){ if(playing)SIM.run('bdPlay'); pass(); });
  SIM.def('bdPlay', function(){
    if(s.done)return;
    playing=!playing;
    SIM.el('bdPlayB').innerHTML=playing?'⏸ pause':'▶▶ play';
    highlight();
    if(playing){
      SIM.el('bdMsg').innerHTML='⏩ Running live loop passes'; SIM.el('bdMsg').style.color='#625D9C';
      function frame(){ if(!playing||s.done)return; var n=s.passes>300?12:s.passes>120?6:1; for(var i=0;i<n&&!s.done;i++)pass(); if(playing&&!s.done)raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame); }
      raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }
  });
  SIM.def('bdReset', function(){
    if(raf)cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf=null; if(coastT)clearTimeout(coastT); coastT=null; playing=false; s=fresh();
    SIM.el('bdPlayB').innerHTML='▶▶ play'; SIM.el('bdPassN').textContent='0';
    row('bdRGap','–'); row('bdRChg','–'); row('bdRCmd','–');
    SIM.el('bdCar').setAttribute('transform','rotate(0)'); SIM.el('bdArc').setAttribute('opacity','0'); SIM.el('bdArc').setAttribute('d','');
    SIM.el('bdMsg').innerHTML='watch 📉 SENSE feed the brake'; SIM.el('bdMsg').style.color='#625D9C';
    highlight();
  });
  SIM.def('bdSet', function(i){
    kp=PRESETS[i].kp; kd=PRESETS[i].kd;
    for(var j=0;j<4;j++){ var c=SIM.el(PRESETS[j].id), on=(j===i); c.style.background=on?PRESETS[j].col:'#eef3f8'; c.style.color=on?'#fff':PRESETS[j].col; }
    SIM.run('bdReset');
    if(i>0) SIM.run('bdPlay');
  });
  SIM.run('bdReset');
})();
</script>
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function(){
  var kd=0.5, raf=null, last=null;
  var X0=50, X1=570, TSPAN=4.0, YB=215, HMAX=115;
  function yOf(h){ return YB - (h/HMAX)*(YB-40); }
  function fresh(){ return {h:0,v:0,lastErr:90,t:0,done:false,pts:[],lx:X0,ly:YB}; }
  function stepc(s, useD){
    SIM.pidTick(s, useD? kd : 0);
    if(s.t>TSPAN) s.done=true;
  }
  function push(s){
    var x=X0+(s.t/TSPAN)*(X1-X0), y=yOf(s.h);
    s.lx=x; s.ly=y;
    s.pts.push(x.toFixed(1)+','+y.toFixed(1));
  }
  SIM.def('fdRun', function(){
    var P=fresh(), PD=fresh(), peak=0; last=null;
    SIM.el('fdLandP').textContent='–'; SIM.el('fdLandPD').textContent='–';
    SIM.el('fdPtrace').setAttribute('points',''); SIM.el('fdPDtrace').setAttribute('points','');
    SIM.el('fdArc').setAttribute('d',''); SIM.el('fdArc').setAttribute('opacity','0');
    SIM.el('fdCarP').setAttribute('transform','rotate(0)'); SIM.el('fdCarPD').setAttribute('transform','rotate(0)');
    function frame(now){
      var dt=last?Math.min((now-last)/1000,0.05):0.016; last=now;
      var n=Math.max(1,Math.round(dt/0.005));
      for(var i=0;i<n;i++){ if(!P.done){stepc(P,false);push(P);} if(!PD.done){stepc(PD,true);push(PD);} }
      SIM.el('fdPtrace').setAttribute('points',P.pts.join(' '));
      SIM.el('fdPDtrace').setAttribute('points',PD.pts.join(' '));
      SIM.el('fdCarP').setAttribute('transform','rotate('+P.h.toFixed(1)+')');
      SIM.el('fdCarPD').setAttribute('transform','rotate('+PD.h.toFixed(1)+')');
      if(P.h>peak)peak=P.h;
      if(peak>90){ SIM.el('fdArc').setAttribute('d',SIM.arcD(90,peak,94)); SIM.el('fdArc').setAttribute('opacity','1'); }
      SIM.el('fdDotP').setAttribute('cx',P.lx.toFixed(1)); SIM.el('fdDotP').setAttribute('cy',P.ly.toFixed(1)); SIM.el('fdDotP').setAttribute('opacity','1');
      SIM.el('fdDotPD').setAttribute('cx',PD.lx.toFixed(1)); SIM.el('fdDotPD').setAttribute('cy',PD.ly.toFixed(1)); SIM.el('fdDotPD').setAttribute('opacity','1');
      var hx=Math.max(P.lx,PD.lx), hy=Math.max(20,Math.min(P.ly,PD.ly)-14);
      SIM.el('fdHere').setAttribute('x',(hx>460?hx-14:hx+14).toFixed(1)); SIM.el('fdHere').setAttribute('y',hy.toFixed(1));
      SIM.el('fdHere').setAttribute('text-anchor', hx>460?'end':'start'); SIM.el('fdHere').setAttribute('opacity','1');
      if(P.done&&PD.done){ raf=null; SIM.el('fdLandP').textContent=P.h.toFixed(0); SIM.el('fdLandPD').textContent=PD.h.toFixed(0); }
      else raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }
    if(raf)cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  });
  SIM.def('fdKd', function(v){ kd=parseFloat(v); SIM.el('fdKdV').textContent=v; });
})();
</script>
```

```{=html}
      <text x="562" y="34" font-size="14" fill="#00AE8D" font-weight="700" text-anchor="end">target 90°</text>
      <polyline id="itTrace" points="" fill="none" stroke="#625D9C" stroke-width="4"/>
      <text id="itGap" x="420" y="78" font-size="15" fill="#E96852" font-weight="700" opacity="0">stuck 5° short 😤</text>

    </svg>

    <span>accumulated error (I memory):</span>
    <div style="width:220px;height:16px;background:#eef3f8;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;"><div id="itAcc" style="height:100%;width:0%;background:#625D9C;"></div></div>
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function(){
  var useI=false, raf=null, last=null;
  var X0=50, X1=570, TSPAN=8.0, YB=175, HMAX=100;
  function yOf(h){ return YB - (h/HMAX)*(YB-25); }
  SIM.def('itRun', function(){
    var T=90, h=0, acc=0, t=0, done=false, pts=[]; last=null;
    var LEAN=16;
    SIM.el('itTrace').setAttribute('points',''); SIM.el('itGap').setAttribute('opacity','0');
    SIM.el('itGapArc').setAttribute('d',''); SIM.el('itGapArc').setAttribute('opacity','0');
    SIM.el('itCar').setAttribute('transform','rotate(0)');
    SIM.el('itAcc').style.width='0%';
    function frame(now){
      var dt=last?Math.min((now-last)/1000,0.05):0.016; last=now;
      var n=Math.max(1,Math.round(dt/0.005));
      for(var i=0;i<n && !done;i++){
        var sd=0.005, err=T-h;
        acc += err*sd;
        var push = 3*err + (useI? 0.3*acc : 0) - LEAN;
        h += push*0.5*sd; t+=sd;
        if(t>TSPAN) done=true;
      }
      var x=X0+(t/TSPAN)*(X1-X0), y=yOf(h);
      pts.push(x.toFixed(1)+','+y.toFixed(1));
      SIM.el('itTrace').setAttribute('points',pts.join(' '));
      SIM.el('itCar').setAttribute('transform','rotate('+h.toFixed(1)+')');
      SIM.el('itDot').setAttribute('cx',x.toFixed(1)); SIM.el('itDot').setAttribute('cy',y.toFixed(1)); SIM.el('itDot').setAttribute('opacity','1');
      SIM.el('itHere').setAttribute('x',(x>460?x-14:x+14).toFixed(1)); SIM.el('itHere').setAttribute('y',Math.max(16,y-14).toFixed(1));
      SIM.el('itHere').setAttribute('text-anchor', x>460?'end':'start'); SIM.el('itHere').setAttribute('opacity','1');
      SIM.el('itAcc').style.width=Math.min(0.3*acc/LEAN*100, 100)+'%';
      if(!done){ raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame); }
      else{
        raf=null;
        if(!useI && h<T-1){
          SIM.el('itGap').setAttribute('opacity','1');
          SIM.el('itGapArc').setAttribute('d',SIM.arcD(h,T,94)); SIM.el('itGapArc').setAttribute('opacity','1');
        }
      }
    }
    if(raf)cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  });
  SIM.def('itToggle', function(){
    useI=!useI;
    var b=SIM.el('itBtn');
    b.textContent='I-term: '+(useI?'ON':'OFF');
    b.style.background=useI?'#625D9C':'#eef3f8';
    b.style.color=useI?'#fff':'#1C355E';
    b.style.border=useI?'none':'2px solid #1C355E';
  });
})();
</script>
```

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.cardbox .purple}
**P alone stalls:** The tiny leftover error makes a push too weak to beat friction.
:::
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.cardbox .teal}
**I (Integral) fixes it:** It adds up the leftover error over time, until the motor is strong enough to beat the drag.
:::
:::
::::
:::

::: {.notes}
Optional coach demo: skip it when bench practice needs the time. Neither implementation nor explanation of I is gated. When a small error remains, `KP * error` is too small to overcome friction, so the robot sits parked short. The integral term adds up the leftover error every millisecond. As time passes, the accumulator grows until it breaks through friction and hits target.
:::

## Optional: the three PID terms 🏆


# C. The Library Begins {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #625D9C)"}

Write each move once in its own file.
Then call it like a sentence.

## Break it: the copy-paste swamp 🔥

::: {.qbox}
[A run needs 4 moves: 2 turns and 2 straights. If you copy-paste the loops, how many lines is that? What happens when you find a bug?]{.qtitle}
:::


::: {.fragment .fade-up}
- 4 moves = **30+ pasted lines**
- One bug means fixing the same code in 4 places 😵
- **The fix:** write each move once, as a named function
:::

::: {.notes}
Students already own functions. Use the pasted loops as a quick retrieval check: which of their functions replaces each block? Then ask what happens when two different program files each contain their own copy of that function. A shared module is the new step today.
:::

## Fix it: Your Own File `movements.py` 📦 {.code-shrink}

```{.python code-line-numbers="|1|2-9|11-13"}
# movements.py -- your own library of robot moves
from pybricks.hubs import PrimeHub
from pybricks.pupdevices import Motor
from pybricks.parameters import Port, Direction
from pybricks.tools import wait

hub = PrimeHub()
left = Motor(Port.F, Direction.COUNTERCLOCKWISE)   # yours
right = Motor(Port.B)                              # yours

KP = 4                                # tuned steering constants
WHEEL_MM = 88                         # measured wheel diameter
DEG_PER_MM = 360 / (3.14 * WHEEL_MM)  # wheel conversion factor
```

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
- **Constants at the top:** ports, tuning numbers, and wheel sizes
- **Functions below:** the moves you call in your missions
- Main program stays clean: `import movements as move`, then `move.turn(90)`
- The `move.` says **which file to open** when a verb misbehaves
:::

::: {.notes}
Walk through creating `movements.py` alongside the main mission script. The import is always named (decision #64): `import movements as move`, never `from movements import …` and never a star. Every call in the mission file then reads `move.drive_straight(300)`, and the prefix tells a debugging student which file to open. Inside `movements.py` the verbs call each other bare, because there they are at home. Keeping constants at the top makes tuning easy and central. All functions inside the library share these settings.
:::

## Knobs with defaults 🎛️ {.smaller}

You have been passing all three numbers: `gyro_turn_pd(90, 4, 0.5)`.
Once your gains are tuned, most calls can reuse them.

```{.python}
def gyro_turn_pd(target, kp=4, kd=0.5):
    ...  # the same PD body

gyro_turn_pd(90)              # uses 4 and 0.5
gyro_turn_pd(90, kd=0)        # change one knob for this call
```

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
::: {.cardbox .teal}
An `=` in the header gives a **default**. A named argument overrides it for **one call**. `target` has no default, so every call must supply it.
:::
:::

::: {.notes}
Predict each call before revealing the card. Then ask what `gyro_turn_pd(kd=0)` is missing: the target. This is the first explanation of defaults. In the next verb, `absolute=False` will be another default; `speed=400` does the same job for the straight. Keep the initial PD lesson on plain parameters so syntax does not compete with derivative reasoning.
:::

## Turn by, or turn to? 🧭

Start facing **30°**. Act out each instruction twice.

| Instruction | First landing | Second landing |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Turn **by** 90° | 120° | 210° |
| Turn **to** 90° | 90° | 90° |

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
::: {.cardbox .purple}
Our verb uses `absolute=True` for **to this heading**. Its default, `absolute=False`, means **by this amount**. The code needs to choose between those two targets.
:::
:::

::: {.notes}
Have a student turn their body or a robot by hand before the code appears. The next slide uses the first if/else to implement the choice they have just demonstrated. The interactive turn slide then checks it on repeated calls.
:::

## New word: `if` 🛣️

::: {.qbox}
[Your turn verb needs to ask **one** question: turn **by** 90, or turn **to** 90?]{.qtitle}
:::

```{.python code-line-numbers="|1|2|3-4"}
if absolute:
    target = angle                       # road 1: absolute is True
else:
    target = hub.imu.heading() + angle   # road 2: absolute is False
```

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
::: {.cardbox .teal}
`if` asks a True or False question **once**, then takes **one** road. Same colon, same indent as `while`. The difference: `while` asks again and again.
:::
:::

::: {.notes}
Two minutes: this is the course's first `if` (decision #65), and it arrives because `turn` needs a fork, not because it is on a syllabus. Ask "which road runs for `turn(90)`?" and "for `turn(90, absolute=True)`?" before the reveal. The contrast with `while` is the point: they already own a True/False check at the top of a block; `if` is that check run once, with no jump back. `elif` waits for the line day, where the eye has more than two answers.
:::

## Verb #1: `turn`, by or to {.code-shrink}

```{.python}
def turn(angle, absolute=False, kp=4, kd=0.5):
    """PD gyro turn. BY this many degrees, or TO this heading."""
    if absolute:
        target = angle                      # face this heading on the mat
    else:
        target = hub.imu.heading() + angle  # add to where the nose points
    ...   # same PD loop as gyro_turn_pd, now chasing target
```

::: {.qbox}
[Press each button **twice**. Which one moves the robot both times?]{.qtitle}
:::

```{=html}
<script>
(function(){
  var cur = 30, raf = null;
  var sect = document.currentScript && document.currentScript.closest('section');
  var codeLines = sect ? sect.querySelectorAll('div.sourceCode code > span') : [];
  function lit(i, col){
    for(var n = 0; n < codeLines.length; n++) codeLines[n].style.background = '';
    if(i >= 0 && codeLines[i]) codeLines[i].style.background = col;
  }
  function pt(a){ var r = a*Math.PI/180; return (94*Math.sin(r)).toFixed(1)+' '+(-94*Math.cos(r)).toFixed(1); }
  function show(){
    SIM.el('tvBot').setAttribute('transform','rotate('+cur.toFixed(1)+')');
    SIM.el('tvHdg').textContent = Math.round(cur);
  }
  function trail(from, to, col){
    var d = to - from;
    if(Math.abs(d) < 0.4){ SIM.el('tvTrail').setAttribute('d',''); return; }
    if(d >  359) to = from + 359;
    if(d < -359) to = from - 359;
    SIM.el('tvTrail').setAttribute('stroke', col);
    SIM.el('tvTrail').setAttribute('d','M '+pt(from)+' A 94 94 0 '+(Math.abs(to-from)>180?1:0)+' '+(d>0?1:0)+' '+pt(to));
  }
  SIM.def('tvTurn', function(absolute){
    if(raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    var col = absolute ? '#00AE8D' : '#E96852';
    var start = cur, target = absolute ? 90 : cur + 90;
    SIM.el('tvHdg').style.color = col;
    SIM.el('tvCalc').innerHTML = absolute
      ? 'target = 90'
      : 'target = ' + Math.round(start) + ' + 90 = ' + Math.round(target);
    SIM.el('tvWhich').innerHTML = absolute
      ? 'line 4 ran: <b style="color:#00AE8D;">TO</b> a heading on the mat'
      : 'line 6 ran: <b style="color:#E96852;">BY</b> 90 from the nose';
    lit(absolute ? 3 : 5, col + '38');
    SIM.el('tvTick').setAttribute('transform','rotate('+target+')');
    SIM.el('tvTick').querySelector('line').setAttribute('stroke', col);
    SIM.el('tvTick').setAttribute('opacity','1');
    var t0 = performance.now(), dur = Math.min(320 + Math.abs(target-start)*3, 1500);
    function step(now){
      var p = Math.min(Math.max((now-t0)/dur, 0), 1), e = p < 0.5 ? 2*p*p : -1+(4-2*p)*p;
      cur = start + (target-start)*e;
      show(); trail(start, cur, col);
      if(p < 1){ raf = requestAnimationFrame(step); } else { cur = target; show(); raf = null; }
    }
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
  });
  SIM.def('tvReset', function(){
    if(raf) cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    raf = null; cur = 30; show(); lit(-1);
    SIM.el('tvTrail').setAttribute('d','');
    SIM.el('tvTick').setAttribute('opacity','0');
    SIM.el('tvHdg').style.color = '#1C355E';
    SIM.el('tvCalc').innerHTML = 'the nose starts 30&#176; off';
    SIM.el('tvWhich').innerHTML = 'no call yet';
  });
})();
</script>
```

::: {.notes}
This is the whole slide, so run it from their answers before you explain anything. Press the coral button: 30 becomes 120, the readout shows `target = 30 + 90`, and **line 6 lights up in the code above**. Press it again: 210. It never lands anywhere in particular, because **by** only knows the nose.

Now the teal button: it swings to 90, line 4 lights instead, and the readout shows `target = 90`. Press it again and **nothing moves** -- that is the moment. Ask why. It is already facing 90, so there is nothing left to do. Then press coral twice more and teal once: it comes straight back to 90 from wherever it wandered. **To** throws the wandering away, which is why missions get written in absolute.

If someone spams coral past 360, let it happen and let teal unwind the long way -- the number really does keep counting up, exactly as they saw on D4, and absolute really does aim at that one number.

Line 3 has no `reset_heading(0)` in it. Mention that and move on, the square slides prove it: one zero for the whole run is what lets an absolute turn swallow the 1° the last one missed.

Do not tell them yet that Pybricks spells this exact signature the exact same way -- that is the D8 reveal, and it lands far harder if they meet it as *their own* design first.
:::

## Verb #2: `drive_straight` (With Finish Line) {.code-shrink}

```{.python code-line-numbers="|1|3|5|6-8|9"}
def drive_straight(distance_mm, speed=400):
    """Drive forward distance_mm while holding heading."""
    heading = hub.imu.heading()                    # lock current heading
    finish = left.angle() + distance_mm * DEG_PER_MM
    while left.angle() < finish:                   # encoder finish line
        error = hub.imu.heading() - heading        # gyro correction
        left.run(speed - KP * error)
        right.run(speed + KP * error)
        wait(5)
    left.stop(); right.stop()
```

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
- The wheel counters work out the **finish line**
- The gyro P-loop **holds the heading straight**
- One function replaces raw motor commands everywhere
:::

::: {.notes}
This first version accepts forward distances only. The wall lesson adds the sign choice for backing off before it uses a negative distance. Combine motor encoders with the gyro. Motor encoders determine forward distance; the gyro detects and counters yaw drift. Notice that `speed=400` in the function header is a default parameter.
:::

## Stretch: the square, in four names

```{.python code-line-numbers="|1|3-6|8"}
import movements as move

def drive_square(side_mm):
    for side in range(4):
        move.drive_straight(side_mm)
        move.turn(90 * (side + 1), absolute=True)

drive_square(300)
```

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
- **Absolute headings:** 90°, 180°, 270°, 360°
- No stacked drift: each turn aims at the mat on its own
- 4 lines replace dozens of hand-written ones 🎯
:::

::: {.notes}
Optional extension after the core benchmarks. `side` takes 0, 1, 2, 3, so `90 * (side + 1)` produces 90, 180, 270, 360 using the familiar counted loop. Compare this against the earlier square. Because the corners are taken with `absolute=True` mat headings rather than relative turns, any angular error from wheel scrub is automatically corrected on the next corner.
:::

```{=html}
<div class="sim">
  <div class="sim-controls">
    <button class="sim-btn coral" data-sim="sqDrive" data-sim-arg="drift">▶ guessed turns</button>
    <button class="sim-btn teal" data-sim="sqDrive" data-sim-arg="heal">▶ drive_straight + turn</button>
  </div>
  <svg width="420" height="360" viewBox="0 0 420 360" style="display:block;margin:0 auto;background:#eef3f8;border-radius:14px;">
    <circle id="sqStart" cx="140" cy="250" r="7" fill="#1C355E"/>
    <text x="140" y="278" font-size="13" fill="#1C355E" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="700">start / finish</text>
    <polyline id="sqTrace" points="" fill="none" stroke="#00C9A7" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <g id="sqBot" transform="translate(140,250)"><g transform="scale(0.5)"><use href="#sim-bot-mini"/></g></g>
    <text id="sqMsg" x="210" y="30" font-size="17" fill="#1C355E" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle"></text>
  </svg>
</div>
<script>
(function(){
  var raf=null, last=null;
  SIM.def('sqDrive', function(mode){
    var side=110, x=140, y=250, h=-90, seg=0, prog=0, pts=['140,250'];
    var drift = mode==='drift' ? 7 : 0;
    var col = mode==='drift' ? '#E96852' : '#00C9A7';
    SIM.el('sqTrace').setAttribute('stroke',col);
    SIM.el('sqTrace').setAttribute('points','140,250');
    SIM.el('sqMsg').textContent=''; SIM.el('sqMsg').setAttribute('fill','#1C355E');
    last=null;
    function frame(now){
      var dt=last?Math.min((now-last)/1000,0.05):0.016; last=now;
      var r=h*Math.PI/180, sp=150;
      x+=sp*Math.cos(r)*dt; y+=sp*Math.sin(r)*dt; prog+=sp*dt;
      pts.push(x.toFixed(1)+','+y.toFixed(1));
      SIM.el('sqTrace').setAttribute('points',pts.join(' '));
      SIM.el('sqBot').setAttribute('transform','translate('+x.toFixed(1)+','+y.toFixed(1)+') rotate('+(h+90).toFixed(1)+')');
      if(prog>=side){ prog=0; seg++; h+=90+drift; if(seg>=4){ raf=null; finish(x,y); return; } }
      raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }
    function finish(fx,fy){
      var gap=Math.hypot(fx-140,fy-250);
      if(mode==='drift'){ SIM.el('sqMsg').setAttribute('fill','#E96852'); SIM.el('sqMsg').textContent='Never closes: gap of '+gap.toFixed(0)+' mm'; }
      else { SIM.el('sqMsg').setAttribute('fill','#00AE8D'); SIM.el('sqMsg').textContent='Snaps shut cleanly 🎯'; }
    }
    if(raf)cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  });
})();
</script>
```

::: {.fragment .fade-up}

- **Today, with absolute headings:** It comes back to the start dot

```{=html}
(function(){
  var raf=null, last=null, nudgeReq=false;

      SIM.el('beBot').setAttribute('transform','translate('+x.toFixed(1)+','+y.toFixed(1)+') rotate('+h.toFixed(1)+')');
      if(x>=719 || t>6){ done=true; }
      if(!done){ raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame); }
      else{ raf=null; SIM.el('beOut').innerHTML='<b>0.0 cm</b> off · measured Ø + healing loop 🎯'; SIM.el('beOut').style.color='#00AE8D'; }
    }
    if(raf)cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  });
  SIM.def('beNudge', function(){ nudgeReq=true; });
})();
</script>
```

- Tests gyro self-healing against table bumps and battery changes
